description:
Suggest whether one NIH application is NITRD from its text.

Returns a calibrated probability, the decision threshold, and the 10
terms that pushed the score up most. It is a suggestion for a human
reviewer, not RCDC coding. Use classifier_explain(task="parent") for
the top 15 terms each way (up and down). An appl_id outside the
FY2015-2023 snapshot is an error.

appl_id.description: NIH application ID (ExPORTER APPLICATION_ID) of one fiscal-year record, e.g. 10506013. Get one from outputs_find_projects.

name: classifier_classify_parent

cohort.description: Where this record sat in model development. 'training' and 'threshold_selection' results are in-sample-ish; 'validation' (other FY2019 half) and 'not_used_in_training' (FY2020-2023) are not.

fy2019_half.description: For FY2019 records: which half of the core_project_num split the record is in. Null for every other fiscal year.

model.description: Which trained model produced a parent suggestion.

threshold_fy.description: Year for threshold selection; validation reported separately on a disjoint FY2019 subset split by core_project_num.

train_fys.description: Fiscal years the model was fitted on.

notice.default: Suggestion only. Not RCDC / demonstration only.

source.description: Where an answer came from. Every read result carries one.

snapshot.default: Fixed snapshot of public NIH ExPORTER FY2015-2023, iCite and PubMed records, loaded 2026-10; no live API calls.
snapshot.description: Data vintage. Results do not reflect later NIH updates.

suggestion.description: abstain = no usable text/features; a human must decide.

top_features.description: Up to 10 terms pushing most toward NITRD, largest first.

items.description: One TF-IDF term's signed contribution for THIS document (not a global weight).

contribution.description: tf-idf value x logistic-regression coefficient, in raw log-odds before calibration. Positive pushes toward NITRD.

field.description: Text field the term came from.

title: Suggest NITRD parent category

description:
Rank the 12 NITRD Program Component Areas for one public NIH application.

Matches the application's title, abstract and PHR against the NITRD
scope vocabulary and returns up to 5 of the 12 PCAs (those with at
least one match, highest score first), with the matched terms. Public
FY2015-2023 projects only. Most useful after classifier_classify_parent
suggests NITRD.

appl_id.description: NIH application ID (ExPORTER APPLICATION_ID) of one fiscal-year record, e.g. 10506013. Get one from outputs_find_projects.

name: classifier_classify_subcategory

notice.default: Ranking signal for a reviewer; scores are not probabilities and are not comparable with parent probabilities. Not RCDC / demonstration only.

ranked_pcas.description: Up to 5 PCAs with at least one match, highest score first (engine order, after its most-specific-PCA rules).

items.description: One PCA from the subcategory scope-vocabulary engine.

matched_terms.description: Scope-vocabulary terms found in the text (why this PCA ranked).

score.description: Engine ranking score; not a probability.

source.description: Where an answer came from. Every read result carries one.

snapshot.default: Fixed snapshot of public NIH ExPORTER FY2015-2023, iCite and PubMed records, loaded 2026-10; no live API calls.
snapshot.description: Data vintage. Results do not reflect later NIH updates.

status.description: no_match = no scope-vocabulary term found; ranked_pcas is empty.

title: Rank NITRD subcategories (PCAs)

description:
Explain the parent (NITRD yes/no) or subcategory (PCA) suggestion.

task="parent": the terms that pushed the score toward and against NITRD,
with exact signed contributions. task="subcategory": each matched PCA
and the scope-vocabulary terms behind it. Explains the model's
behaviour, not whether the suggestion is correct.

appl_id.description: NIH application ID (ExPORTER APPLICATION_ID) of one fiscal-year record, e.g. 10506013. Get one from outputs_find_projects.

name: classifier_explain

caveats.description: Limits of the explanation, e.g. contributions are pre-calibration.

items.description: One TF-IDF term's signed contribution for THIS document (not a global weight).

contribution.description: tf-idf value x logistic-regression coefficient, in raw log-odds before calibration. Positive pushes toward NITRD.

field.description: Text field the term came from.

features.description: task=parent only: up to 15 terms each way (toward and against NITRD), by absolute contribution. Null for subcategory.

method.description: parent: exact per-term log-odds contributions of the linear model. subcategory: scope-vocabulary matches per PCA.

items.description: One PCA from the subcategory scope-vocabulary engine.

matched_terms.description: Scope-vocabulary terms found in the text (why this PCA ranked).

score.description: Engine ranking score; not a probability.

pca_matches.description: task=subcategory only: each matched PCA and its terms; else null.

source.description: Where an answer came from. Every read result carries one.

snapshot.default: Fixed snapshot of public NIH ExPORTER FY2015-2023, iCite and PubMed records, loaded 2026-10; no live API calls.
snapshot.description: Data vintage. Results do not reflect later NIH updates.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences for a reviewer.
